snippet.title: MiniCar Shop Simulator Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
MiniCar Shop Game

 You can live out your fantasy of owning a toy store that only sells miniature cars.  You can collect and trade more than 300 different model cars in this simulator. They range from sports cars to military vehicles to supercars from the future.  Look for uncommon models, uncover mystery boxes, and add to your collection.

 You may make your shop bigger and more personal by adding different types of furniture, decorations, and paint colors.  You can hire somebody to run the counter while you do other things.  The fun doesn't stop with shopping; you may race your cars on one of six complex tracks, each with its own set of challenges.

 You can also do delivery missions where you ride a scooter to convey orders to consumers and find inventive ways to get there faster.  Customers will be dancing, there will be goofy challenges, and other funny surprises in a playful and surprising setting.

 Minimum System Requirements

 Windows 10 is the operating system.

 Intel Core i5-4670 or AMD FX-8150 processor

 4 GB of RAM

 Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 2GB or AMD Radeon R7 265 2GB

 Version 11 of DirectX

 Storage: 1 GB of space is free

Ref Link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3626820/MiniCar_Shop_Simulator/?snr=1_7_7_230_150_1
